findings.title: Missing second cache check after acquiring write lock
findings.body: GetWebAssets does a check under RLock at line 45 and then acquires the write Lock at line 48 without re-checking entryPointAssetsCache. Two goroutines that both observe ret==nil can then both proceed to do file/CDN I/O sequentially and publish. This causes thundering-herd I/O on cold start and allows a later writer to overwrite a good value just published by an earlier writer, including overwriting it with a failure.

findings.title: Failure result unconditionally overwrites cache
findings.body: Line 69 does entryPointAssetsCache = result even when readWebAssetsFromFile/CDN returned an error and result is nil. Combined with the missing re-check, a transient failure in one concurrent caller wipes a good EntryPointAssets value just cached by another caller, turning subsequent requests into errors and forcing repeated disk reads. The cache should only be updated when err==nil and result!=nil.
